items.title: A $1,200,000 Portfolio in Watsco, Truist and Eversource Pays $51,753 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $1,200,000 portfolio split evenly across Watsco, Truist Financial and Eversource Energy pays about $51,800 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $4,310 a month. Eversource’s dividend rose every year from fiscal 2016 to fiscal 2025 at a steady share of earnings, while Truist’s is well covered but hasn’t been raised since 2022.
